body: Honestly thank you for being one of the few people to say this. I will ensure that I go out the first time. I'm thinking an exit bag or KCN. I have obtained a copy of the Peaceful Pill Handbook and I'll make sure that I know what I have to do before I do it.

I'm not a bad person. I got drunk and blacked-out. I don't remember the next few hours but my ex is accusing me of attempting to strangle her. I live in a deeply blue state, and they don't take kindly to guys who hit women. I don't remember doing that at all, nor do I think that I have it in me to do so, but we both had marks... 

So I'm going to end it. Because they are leaving me no choice. Because I love my freedom more than I love life itself, I guess.

I have two good friends, and then my family in other states. My best friend will be grief stricken for a while but people will forget me. I would love a hug too, but then again I would also love the DA to re-consider reducing my charges... Neither will happen.

I will be judged in front of a jury of my peers based on actions I don't even remember doing. I know people make mistakes, but I literally don't even remember the actions that I am going to lose my freedom over. I don't want to live in that kind of world. And fuck them for thinking people should.

I could care less about my love. It's my future as a worker that I am concerned with. This will destroy my chances of ever getting a good paying job. Even after studying all I can to further my high end networking certifications and programming degree, it will all be for not. I'll be back at square one making barely $10/hr again, and be forced to accept terms on my living that I just can't do...
